article.title: Life on the edge of Israel’s occupation in southern Lebanon
article.author: Silvia Casadei
article.content: As part of a U.S.-brokered agreement with Israel and Lebanon, residents of some southern villages are cautiously returning to their homes. What they have found is a shell of their former lives, and a daily menacing presence of the Israeli occupation.
